This report fits every Study 2 model reported in the main text and the
Supplemental Materials, draws Figure 4, and ends with a table of each reported
number and the model it comes from (Section 12).

The data are the index-finger points that Kita, Brentari and Goldin-Meadow
(2025) identified in two sessions of four homesigning children and their
hearing mothers. Kita et al. timed the stroke of each point. Each point was
re-coded so that the annotation runs from the onset of the stroke to the
release of the hold, giving three measures per point: the stroke, the hold
(the re-coded point minus the stroke) and the whole point.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r packages}
source("../R/helpers.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
  library(bayestestR)
})
```

# Data

```{r data}
raw <- read.csv("data/kita_points_duration_recoded.csv",
                check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(nrow(raw) == 1123)

d_all <- raw %>%
  rename(total_ms = `stroke+hold_ms`) %>%
  mutate(person      = factor(person, levels = c("Child", "Mom")),
         person_lab  = factor(if_else(person == "Child", "Homesigning children", "Mothers"),
                              levels = c("Homesigning children", "Mothers")),
         family      = factor(subject),
         participant = factor(paste(subject, person, sep = "_")),
         session_id  = factor(paste(subject, session, sep = ".")),
         stroke_sec  = stroke_ms / 1000,
         total_sec   = total_ms / 1000,
         hold_sec    = hold_ms / 1000,
         log_stroke  = log(stroke_sec),
         log_total   = log(total_sec),
         hold_prop   = hold_ms / total_ms,
         floored     = hold_raw_ms < 0,
         age_months  = as.numeric(age_at_session_months))
```

Table S5: points coded, by session.

```{r table-s5}
d_all %>% count(session = as.character(session_id), person) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person, values_from = n) %>%
  bind_rows(summarise(., session = "Total", Child = sum(Child), Mom = sum(Mom))) %>%
  kable()
```

A point made with both hands was coded once for each hand. Annotations that
share a point identifier and overlap in time are treated as one point, and the
longer annotation is kept. Annotations that share an identifier but do not
overlap are separate points.

```{r one-row-per-point}
d_all <- d_all %>%
  group_by(subject, session, kita_id) %>%
  mutate(event_n  = n(),
         overlaps = event_n > 1 & max(eaf_onset_ms) < min(eaf_offset_ms),
         event_id = paste(subject, session, kita_id,
                          if_else(overlaps, "E", as.character(row_number())), sep = "_")) %>%
  ungroup()
dat <- d_all %>% group_by(event_id) %>%
  slice_max(total_ms, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup()

# Whether a point was produced alone or with other gestures, from the
# utterance coding (available for all but two points).
combo <- dat %>%
  filter(gm_accompanied %in% c("TRUE", "FALSE")) %>%
  mutate(alone = factor(if_else(gm_accompanied == "TRUE", "In combination", "Alone"),
                        levels = c("In combination", "Alone")),
         accompanied = as.integer(gm_accompanied == "TRUE"),
         n_companions = as.numeric(gm_n_companions))

# Handshape at the end of the stroke, coded crisp or sloppy by Kita et al.
crisp <- dat %>%
  filter(sloppiness_offset %in% c("crisp", "sloppy")) %>%
  mutate(crispness = factor(sloppiness_offset, levels = c("sloppy", "crisp")))

# One row per point and phase, for the model of stroke and hold together.
phase_dat <- dat %>%
  select(event_id, participant, session_id, person, person_lab, family, stroke_sec, hold_sec) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(stroke_sec, hold_sec), names_to = "phase", values_to = "dur_sec") %>%
  mutate(phase = factor(if_else(phase == "stroke_sec", "Stroke", "Hold"),
                        levels = c("Stroke", "Hold")))

stopifnot(all(dat$stroke_sec > 0), all(dat$total_sec > 0), all(dat$hold_sec >= 0),
          all(dat$stroke_ms + dat$hold_ms == dat$total_ms | dat$floored),
          all(dat$hold_ms[dat$floored] == 0))

dat %>% group_by(person_lab) %>%
  summarise(points = n(), stroke_s = mean(stroke_sec), hold_s = mean(hold_sec),
            whole_s = mean(total_sec), no_hold = sum(hold_sec == 0),
            hold_set_to_zero = sum(floored), .groups = "drop") %>%
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Points analyzed (arithmetic means in seconds)")
c(points = nrow(dat), context_coded = nrow(combo), alone = sum(combo$alone == "Alone"),
  hold_zero = sum(dat$hold_sec == 0), hold_set_to_zero = sum(dat$floored))
```


# Priors

As in Study 1, except that the intercept is Normal(-1, 1), which places 95%
of the prior mass on geometric means between about 0.05 s and 2.7 s. For the
hurdle part of the hold models (the probability that a point has no hold):
intercept Normal(0, 1.5), effects Normal(0, 1).

```{r priors}
std_priors <- c(prior(normal(-1, 1), class = Intercept),
                prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
hurdle_priors <- c(std_priors,
                   prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = Intercept, dpar = "hu"),
                   prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, dpar = "hu"))

ADAPT <- 0.99
fit <- function(name, formula, data, prior = std_priors, family = gaussian(), adapt = ADAPT, ...)
  fit_or_load(name, formula, data, prior, family, adapt_delta = adapt, ...)

# Child is the reference level, so b_personMom is the mother - child contrast.
draws_of <- function(m, par) as_draws_df(m)[[par]]
geo_means <- function(m, b = "b_personMom", int = "b_Intercept", inv = exp) {
  d <- as_draws_df(m)
  bind_rows(summ(inv(d[[int]]), "Children"), summ(inv(d[[int]] + d[[b]]), "Mothers")) %>%
    select(term, estimate, lower, upper)
}
share_within <- function(x, w) mean(abs(x) < w)
```

Every model has random intercepts for participant (eight: four children and
four mothers) and session (eight). Each session is shared by a child and
their mother, so the child-mother comparison is made within session.

```{r prior-predictive, fig.height = 3.5}
m_prior <- fit("prior_only_total",
               bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)),
               dat, sample_prior = "only")
round(quantile(exp(posterior_predict(m_prior, ndraws = 400)), c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)), 3)
```

# Whole point

```{r whole-point, fig.height = 3.5}
m_total <- fit("total_person",
               bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)), dat)
kable(convergence(m_total, "Whole point"), digits = 3)
pp_check(m_total, ndraws = 100) + labs(x = "log duration") + theme_minimal()
kable(geo_means(m_total), digits = 2, caption = "Geometric mean duration (s)")
whole <- draws_of(m_total, "b_personMom")
kable(summ(whole, "Mother - child (log-seconds)"), digits = 3)
```

# Stroke

```{r stroke, fig.height = 3.5}
m_stroke <- fit("stroke_person",
                bf(log_stroke ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)), dat)
kable(convergence(m_stroke, "Stroke"), digits = 3)
pp_check(m_stroke, ndraws = 100) + labs(x = "log duration") + theme_minimal()
kable(geo_means(m_stroke), digits = 2, caption = "Geometric mean duration (s)")
stroke <- draws_of(m_stroke, "b_personMom")
kable(summ(stroke, "Mother - child (log-seconds)"), digits = 3)

# The 95% highest-density interval lies inside neither region of practical equivalence
c(within_0.10 = share_within(stroke, 0.10), within_0.20 = share_within(stroke, 0.20),
  p_difference_over_20_percent = mean(abs(stroke) > log(1.2)),
  whole_point_within_0.10 = share_within(whole, 0.10))
hdi(stroke, ci = 0.95)
```

# Hold

The hold is zero for some points, so it is modeled with a hurdle log-normal
likelihood, which estimates separately the probability that a point has no
hold and the length of the hold when there is one.

```{r hold, fig.height = 3.5}
m_hold <- fit("hold_person",
              bf(hold_sec ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id),
                 hu ~ person + (1 | participant)),
              dat, prior = hurdle_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())
kable(convergence(m_hold, "Hold"), digits = 3)
pp_check(m_hold, ndraws = 100) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 5)) + theme_minimal()
kable(geo_means(m_hold), digits = 2, caption = "Hold length when there is a hold (s)")
kable(summ(draws_of(m_hold, "b_personMom"), "Mother - child (log-seconds)"), digits = 3)

m_hold_nf <- fit("hold_nofloor",
                 bf(hold_sec ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id),
                    hu ~ person + (1 | participant)),
                 filter(dat, !floored), prior = hurdle_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())
kable(geo_means(m_hold_nf, b = "b_hu_personMom", int = "b_hu_Intercept", inv = plogis),
      digits = 2, caption = "Probability that a point has no hold (without the 30 points set to zero)")
bind_rows(summ(draws_of(m_hold, "b_hu_personMom"), "All points"),
          summ(draws_of(m_hold_nf, "b_hu_personMom"), "Without the 30 points set to zero")) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Mother - child difference in P(no hold), log-odds")
```

# Stroke and hold together

One model of both phases of every point. The phase-by-person interaction is
the difference between the mother - child contrast in the hold and in the
stroke. A point-level intercept pairs the two phases of each point; random
phase slopes for participant and session stop the interaction from being
estimated as if it rested on 2,234 independent observations; and the residual
standard deviation differs by phase. LKJ(2) prior on the random-effect
correlations.

```{r phase}
phase_priors <- c(prior(normal(-1, 1), class = Intercept),
                  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                  prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                  prior(lkj(2), class = cor),
                  prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept, dpar = "sigma"),
                  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b, dpar = "sigma"),
                  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = Intercept, dpar = "hu"),
                  prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, dpar = "hu"))
m_phase <- fit("phase_person_full",
               bf(dur_sec ~ phase * person + (1 + phase | participant) +
                    (1 + phase | session_id) + (1 | event_id),
                  hu ~ phase * person, sigma ~ phase),
               phase_dat, prior = phase_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())

# Alternative specifications (Table S6B)
phase_pos <- phase_dat %>% filter(dur_sec > 0) %>% mutate(ld = log(dur_sec))
m_phase_pos <- fit("phase_positive",
                   bf(ld ~ phase * person + (1 + phase | participant) +
                        (1 + phase | session_id) + (1 | event_id), sigma ~ phase),
                   phase_pos,
                   prior = c(prior(normal(-1, 1), class = Intercept),
                             prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                             prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                             prior(lkj(2), class = cor),
                             prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept, dpar = "sigma"),
                             prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b, dpar = "sigma")))
m_phase_simple <- fit("phase_person",
                      bf(dur_sec ~ phase * person + (1 | event_id) + (1 | participant) +
                           (1 | session_id), hu ~ phase * person),
                      phase_dat, prior = hurdle_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())

d <- as_draws_df(m_phase)
interaction <- d$`b_phaseHold:personMom`
bind_rows(summ(d$b_personMom, "Mother - child, stroke"),
          summ(d$b_personMom + interaction, "Mother - child, hold"),
          summ(interaction, "Interaction (primary model)"),
          summ(draws_of(m_phase_simple, "b_phaseHold:personMom"),
               "Interaction, no random slopes, one residual SD"),
          summ(draws_of(m_phase_pos, "b_phaseHold:personMom"),
               "Interaction, positive durations only")) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Phase by person (log-seconds)")

# A check that does not depend on the model: for each dyad and each session,
# the hold contrast minus the stroke contrast in mean log duration (holds
# longer than zero), tested against zero.
by_unit <- function(unit) dat %>% filter(hold_sec > 0) %>%
  group_by(.data[[unit]], person) %>%
  summarise(hold = mean(log(hold_sec)), stroke = mean(log_stroke), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = person, values_from = c(hold, stroke)) %>%
  mutate(contrast = (hold_Mom - hold_Child) - (stroke_Mom - stroke_Child))
for (unit in c("family", "session_id")) {
  x <- by_unit(unit); tt <- t.test(x$contrast)
  cat(sprintf("%s: mean %.3f, SD %.3f, t(%d) = %.2f, p = %.3f\n", unit,
              mean(x$contrast), sd(x$contrast), tt$parameter, tt$statistic, tt$p.value))
}
```

# The child-mother contrast within each dyad

```{r per-dyad}
m_dyad_total <- fit("perdyad_total",
                    bf(log_total ~ person * family + (1 | session_id)), dat)
m_dyad_stroke <- fit("perdyad_stroke",
                     bf(log_stroke ~ person * family + (1 | session_id)), dat)
m_dyad_hold <- fit("perdyad_hold",
                   bf(hold_sec ~ person * family + (1 | session_id), hu ~ person),
                   dat, prior = hurdle_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())

per_dyad <- function(m, measure) {
  d <- as_draws_df(m); fams <- levels(dat$family)
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(fams), function(i) {
    x <- d$b_personMom
    if (i > 1) x <- x + d[[paste0("b_personMom:family", fams[i])]]
    summ(x, fams[i])
  })) %>% mutate(measure = measure)
}
dyads <- bind_rows(per_dyad(m_dyad_total, "Whole point"),
                   per_dyad(m_dyad_hold, "Hold"),
                   per_dyad(m_dyad_stroke, "Stroke"))
kable(dyads, digits = 3, caption = "Table S7: mother - child within each dyad (log-seconds)")
```

# Points produced alone

```{r isolation}
m_iso_total <- fit("iso_total",
                   bf(log_total ~ alone * person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)), combo)
m_iso_stroke <- fit("iso_stroke",
                    bf(log_stroke ~ alone * person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)), combo)

iso_effects <- function(m, measure) {
  d <- as_draws_df(m); ix <- d$`b_aloneAlone:personMom`
  bind_rows(summ(d$b_personMom, "Mother - child, with other gestures"),
            summ(d$b_personMom + ix, "Mother - child, alone"),
            summ(d$b_aloneAlone, "Alone - with other gestures, children"),
            summ(d$b_aloneAlone + ix, "Alone - with other gestures, mothers"),
            summ(ix, "Isolation by person interaction")) %>%
    mutate(measure = measure)
}
iso <- bind_rows(iso_effects(m_iso_total, "Whole point"), iso_effects(m_iso_stroke, "Stroke"))
kable(iso, digits = 3, caption = "Table S6C (log-seconds)")
```

# Handshape crispness

```{r crispness}
table(crisp$person_lab, crisp$crispness)
m_crisp_stroke <- fit("crisp_stroke",
                      bf(log_stroke ~ crispness * person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)),
                      crisp)
m_crisp_hold <- fit("crisp_hold",
                    bf(hold_sec ~ crispness * person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id),
                       hu ~ crispness + person),
                    crisp, prior = hurdle_priors, family = hurdle_lognormal())
bind_rows(summ(draws_of(m_crisp_stroke, "b_crispnesscrisp"), "Stroke: crisp - sloppy, children"),
          summ(draws_of(m_crisp_stroke, "b_crispnesscrisp:personMom"), "Stroke: crispness by person"),
          summ(draws_of(m_crisp_hold, "b_crispnesscrisp"), "Hold length: crisp - sloppy, children"),
          summ(draws_of(m_crisp_hold, "b_crispnesscrisp:personMom"), "Hold length: crispness by person"),
          summ(draws_of(m_crisp_hold, "b_hu_crispnesscrisp"), "P(no hold): crisp - sloppy (log-odds)")) %>%
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Table S6D")
```

# Alternative specifications of the whole-point model

Thirteen refits of the whole-point model, each changing one aspect of it
(Table S8).

```{r alternatives, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5}
f_total <- bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id))

m_wide <- fit("total_person_wide", f_total, dat,
              prior = c(prior(normal(-1, 2), class = Intercept),
                        prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                        prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                        prior(exponential(1), class = sigma)))
m_sd2 <- fit("total_person_narrowsd", f_total, dat,
             prior = c(prior(normal(-1, 1), class = Intercept),
                       prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                       prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
                       prior(exponential(1), class = sigma)))
# The family-level fits have four levels, so adapt_delta is raised.
m_family <- fit("total_person_family",
                bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id) + (1 | family)),
                dat, adapt = 0.999)
m_family_slope <- fit("total_person_familyslope",
                      bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id) +
                           (1 + person || family)),
                      dat, adapt = 0.999)
utterances <- dat %>% filter(!gm_utt_num %in% c("", NA)) %>%
  mutate(utt_id = factor(paste(session_id, person, gm_utt_num, sep = "_")))
m_utterance <- fit("total_person_utt",
                   bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id) + (1 | utt_id)),
                   utterances)
m_gamma <- fit("total_gamma",
               bf(total_sec ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)), dat,
               prior = c(prior(normal(-1, 1), class = Intercept),
                         prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                         prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
                         prior(exponential(1), class = shape)),
               family = Gamma(link = "log"))
m_person_session <- fit("total_ps",
                        bf(log_total ~ person + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id) + (1 | ps)),
                        mutate(dat, ps = interaction(participant, session_id, drop = TRUE)))
m_companions <- fit("total_ncomp",
                    bf(log_total ~ person + ncomp + (1 | participant) + (1 | session_id)),
                    combo %>% mutate(ncomp = as.numeric(gm_n_companions)) %>% filter(!is.na(ncomp)))
m_no_zero_holds <- refit_on("sub_no_floored_total", m_total, filter(dat, !floored))
m_without <- lapply(setNames(levels(dat$family), levels(dat$family)), function(f)
  refit_on(paste0("loso_", f, "_total"), m_total, filter(dat, family != f)))

alternatives <- c(
  list("Wider priors: intercept Normal(-1, 2), fixed effects Normal(0, 1)" = m_wide,
       "Random-effect SDs Exponential(2)" = m_sd2,
       "Added family intercept" = m_family,
       "Added person slope by family" = m_family_slope,
       "Added utterance intercept" = m_utterance,
       "Gamma likelihood" = m_gamma,
       "Added person-by-session intercept" = m_person_session,
       "Number of accompanying gestures as covariate" = m_companions,
       "Without the 30 points with hold set to zero" = m_no_zero_holds),
  setNames(m_without, paste("Without family", names(m_without))))

table_s8 <- bind_rows(
  summ(whole, "Primary model") %>% mutate(N = nobs(m_total)),
  bind_rows(Map(function(m, label) summ(draws_of(m, "b_personMom"), label) %>% mutate(N = nobs(m)),
                alternatives, names(alternatives))))
kable(select(table_s8, term, N, estimate, lower, upper, p_positive), digits = 3,
      caption = "Table S8: mother - child, whole point (log-seconds)")

ggplot(table_s8, aes(estimate, reorder(term, estimate))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper)) +
  labs(x = "Mother - child (log-seconds), 89% credible interval", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

# Figure 4

Density of point durations for children and mothers: the whole point (top) and
the stroke (bottom), for all points (left) and points produced alone (right).
Dashed lines are arithmetic means.

```{r figure-4, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7.5}
person_cols <- c("Homesigning children" = "#619CFF", "Mothers" = "#F8766D")
panel <- bind_rows(dat %>% mutate(set = "All points"),
                   combo %>% filter(alone == "Alone") %>% mutate(set = "Isolated points only")) %>%
  mutate(Stroke = stroke_sec, `Stroke + hold` = total_sec) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Stroke, `Stroke + hold`), names_to = "measure", values_to = "sec") %>%
  mutate(measure = factor(measure, levels = c("Stroke + hold", "Stroke")),
         set = factor(set, levels = c("All points", "Isolated points only")))
panel_means <- panel %>% group_by(set, measure, person_lab) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(sec), sd = sd(sec), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
kable(panel_means, digits = 2)

ggplot(panel, aes(x = sec, fill = person_lab, colour = person_lab)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(data = panel_means, aes(xintercept = m, colour = person_lab),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ set, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = person_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = person_cols) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 3)) +
  labs(x = "Duration (seconds)", y = "Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 15), axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15), legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "lines"), legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "lines"))
```

# Convergence (Table S9)

```{r convergence}
reported <- c(
  list("Stroke" = m_stroke, "Whole point" = m_total, "Hold" = m_hold,
       "Hold, without points with hold set to zero" = m_hold_nf,
       "Phase model, primary" = m_phase,
       "Phase model, no random slopes, one residual SD" = m_phase_simple,
       "Phase model, positive durations only" = m_phase_pos,
       "Whole point x isolation" = m_iso_total, "Stroke x isolation" = m_iso_stroke,
       "Stroke x crispness" = m_crisp_stroke, "Hold x crispness" = m_crisp_hold,
       "Per dyad, whole point" = m_dyad_total, "Per dyad, hold" = m_dyad_hold,
       "Per dyad, stroke" = m_dyad_stroke),
  setNames(alternatives, paste("Whole point,", names(alternatives))))
conv <- bind_rows(Map(convergence, reported, names(reported)))
kable(conv, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Numbers reported in the manuscript

```{r manuscript-numbers}
fmt <- function(r, p_label = "P") sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]; %s = %.3f",
                                          r$estimate, r$lower, r$upper, p_label, r$p_positive)
gm <- function(m) with(geo_means(m), sprintf("children %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]; mothers %.2f [%.2f, %.2f]",
  estimate[1], lower[1], upper[1], estimate[2], lower[2], upper[2]))
no_hold <- geo_means(m_hold_nf, b = "b_hu_personMom", int = "b_hu_Intercept", inv = plogis)
conv_text <- function(labels) with(conv[conv$model %in% labels, ],
  sprintf("max R-hat %.3f; min bulk ESS %.0f; divergences %s",
          max(max_rhat), min(bulk_ess_fixed), paste(divergences, collapse = "/")))

data.frame(
  result = c("Points: children, mothers",
             "Points with no hold",
             "Whole point: convergence",
             "Whole point: mother - child; P(mother > child)",
             "Whole point: geometric means (s)",
             "Whole point: P(mother > child) in each dyad",
             "Whole point: range over 13 alternative specifications",
             "Whole point, with other gestures",
             "Whole point, alone",
             "Stroke, hold and phase models: convergence",
             "Stroke: mother - child",
             "Stroke: geometric means (s)",
             "Stroke: posterior within +/-0.20",
             "Hold length: mother - child",
             "Hold length: geometric means (s)",
             "P(no hold): children vs. mothers",
             "Phase by person interaction"),
  value = c(sprintf("%d, %d", sum(dat$person == "Child"), sum(dat$person == "Mom")),
            sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(dat$hold_sec == 0), 100 * mean(dat$hold_sec == 0)),
            conv_text("Whole point"),
            fmt(summ(whole)),
            gm(m_total),
            paste(sprintf("%.3f", dyads$p_positive[dyads$measure == "Whole point"]), collapse = ", "),
            sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", min(table_s8$estimate[-1]), max(table_s8$estimate[-1])),
            fmt(iso[1, ]),
            fmt(iso[2, ]),
            conv_text(c("Stroke", "Hold", "Phase model, primary")),
            fmt(summ(stroke)),
            gm(m_stroke),
            sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share_within(stroke, 0.20)),
            fmt(summ(draws_of(m_hold, "b_personMom"))),
            gm(m_hold),
            sprintf("%.2f vs. %.2f", no_hold$estimate[1], no_hold$estimate[2]),
            fmt(summ(interaction)))) %>%
  kable()
```
